brief: Opens an existing file for reading only and answers questions about its text and lines.
detail: Reach for it when you must not change the file: every writing class is built on the same reading methods (Lines, Line, FindText, LinesContaining...), which live in stzFileReadingMixin and are documented there. Building a reader on a path with no file raises an error and creates nothing.
receiver:
write("demo_note.txt", "alpha" + char(10) + "beta gamma" + char(10) + "end")
o1 = new stzFileReader("demo_note.txt")
